newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia details plans for Svyazinvest telecom sale.
newsitem.headline: Russia details plans for Svyazinvest telecom sale.

text.p: Russia announced terms on Monday for the auction of a 25 percent plus one share stake in telecoms holding company AO Svyazinvest to be held on July 25.
Bids for the stake will be accepted from June 23 until July 21, the Russian Federal Property Fund which is organising the tender said in its Reforma bulletin.
Foreign applicants have the right to participate.
More than 4.8 billion shares, each with a nominal value of 1,000 roubles, will be offered as a single tranche, it said. The starting value of the stake is $1.18 billion.
The potential participants in the auction must pay a deposit of 2.32 trillion roubles or $400 million by July 21, the bulletin said.

The winner of the auction will be the participant who offers the highest price for the purchase of Svyazinvest's stake. If two or more participants offer the same price the winner will be the one who paid his deposit first, it added.
The deposit will be included as part of the price of the stake. Half of the final price agreed for the shares must be paid within 15 days of the deal being agreed and the remainder within 75 days.
The winner of the auction is to be announced on July 25, at 1300 GMT.
The government's need to plug a huge budget deficit has given a fresh impetus to its plans to sell the Svyazinvest stake, which it has been trying to sell since 1995.
Svyazinvest, one of Russia's biggest companies, owns controlling stakes in 85 regional telecoms companies.
